summary: Frontend-only regression for CoinQuest child UX upgrades: filling jars, mute toggle, homework missions, learn journey map, goal-complete + badge-claim celebrations. All 8 requested flows pass. Only caveat: wallet_demo_child currently has just one journey stop (the current one) so 'locked stop toast' behavior could not be exercised in-app — code path in LearnPage renders locked stops with data-testid='journey-stop-locked-<id>' but no locked stops were available in seeded data at test time.

issues: Quick-transfer icon-only button on top-right (near 'Add to Goal') has no data-testid, no visible label, and no aria-label/title; hard to discover for users and for automated tests.

Outer <div data-testid='journey-stop-<id>'> is not itself clickable; navigation only works when user clicks the inner <a> wrapping the image. Consider wrapping the whole stop in the Link (or adding onClick) to enlarge the hit-target.

action_items: Optional: add data-testid + aria-label to the quick-transfer icon button on /savings-goals for accessibility & test-ability.
Optional: make the entire journey-stop card a Link (wrap outer div) so any tap on the stop navigates, not just the image.
Ensure at least one locked topic remains for wallet_demo_child in seed so the 'locked stop → info toast' path can be QA'd end-to-end (currently no locked stops exist for this user).

Celebration mute toggle button renders an <svg> icon only; inner_text is empty. Fine functionally but consider adding aria-label='Mute celebration sounds' / title for a11y (data-testid works, but screen readers won't announce state).
